objective: identify which causal technical feature families add stable out-of-sample information to the nonredundant MFE D10 and D20 opportunity heads

data.row_universe: all point-in-time A-share main-board candidates in the learnability input, without filtering on future fills or labels
data.base_feature_profile: 296 continuous and 5 train-mapped categorical features known by signal-date close

labels.semantics: highest legal entry-relative close opportunity through H days, excluding D1 under T+1

feature_groups.layout: one feature-major float32 candidate-aligned file per family

common_rules.price_scale: price-derived features use ratios, log distances, standardized values, or bounded states
common_rules.missingness: retain causal missing values and never backfill from a future bar

semantics.recent_kline_sequence: lags 1 through 9 of normalized OHLC, candle, amount-surprise, and relative-turnover channels plus signal-day signed body
semantics.breakout_retest_levels: distances and ages for prior 20/60/120/252-day highs and lows plus confirmed breakout and retest context
semantics.long_daily_context: returns and rolling trend, volatility, range, amount, and efficiency descriptors at 120, 180, and 252 days
semantics.completed_week_month_context: trend and range descriptors over completed 4/13/26/52-week and 3/6/12/24-month windows, excluding the current partial period
semantics.traditional_indicators: causal KAMA, MACD, KDJ, and RSI recurrences
semantics.confirmed_swing_structure: three-bar and five-bar pivots exposed only after right-side confirmation, used as a causal swing proxy
semantics.turnover_cost_proxy: daily typical-price cohorts weighted by recovered float turnover; this is an estimate, not exchange-provided chip distribution
semantics.deterministic_noise: 32 candidate-id keyed pseudo-random columns generated from a fixed seed as a negative control

folds.fold_role: owner-authorized repeatedly reused recent decision folds, not a pristine holdout
folds.rule: expanding history with horizon-specific label purge before each outer year

iteration_selection.source: baseline features on the immediately preceding complete calendar year
iteration_selection.refit: use the selected tree count for every baseline and family variant in the same horizon-year

folds.sample_weight: each signal date has equal total weight; missing MFE rows stay aligned with zero target weight

evaluation.comparison: base features versus base plus exactly one family
evaluation.overlap_control: Newey-West HAC on paired daily deltas with lag H-1
evaluation.cross_year_support: one-sided Stouffer combination across the three years while retaining year-level effect gates

family_status.core: both MFE D10 and D20 heads pass
family_status.specialized: exactly one head passes and the other has no material IC or Top-5 mean harm
family_status.omit: no head passes or a nonpassing head has material harm

decision.negative_control_rule: if deterministic_noise passes either horizon, invalidate the feature-family decision
decision.next_step: only non-omitted families may enter a later state10 incremental audit
